classification_policy: Official institutional or regulator evidence required; no silent inference.

records.name: Presidency University Kolkata
records.evidence: The university's official institutional information describes Presidency University Kolkata as a university established by the Government of West Bengal under the Presidency University Act, 2010, and its official site publishes undergraduate and postgraduate admissions.
records.notes: State public university; no matching canonical family row was found in the families table.

records.name: Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC)
records.statutory_basis: Constituent college of the University of Delhi (Central University)
records.evidence: SRCC's official website states that Shri Ram College of Commerce is a constituent college of the University of Delhi; its official prospectus and departments pages list undergraduate and postgraduate courses and admissions.
records.notes: Constituent-college row, not a separate university.

records.name: Loyola College
records.statutory_basis: UGC autonomous college affiliated to the University of Madras; grant-in-aid and self-financing institution
records.evidence: Loyola's official profile identifies it as Loyola College (Autonomous), affiliated to the University of Madras, with grant-in-aid and self-financing categories, UGC recognition and undergraduate, postgraduate and PhD programmes.
records.notes: Autonomous affiliated college; degrees are conferred by the University of Madras.

records.name: St. Xaviers College
records.statutory_basis: Empowered autonomous constituent college affiliated to the University of Mumbai under the Maharashtra State Public Universities Act, 2016
records.evidence: The official handbook states that St. Xavier's College is an empowered autonomous college affiliated with the University of Mumbai and conducts government-aided and self-financing degree courses; the official admissions site lists current UG and PG admissions.
records.notes: Name retained exactly as supplied; official branding uses St. Xavier's College.

records.name: Narsee Monjee College of Commerce and Economics
records.statutory_basis: Empowered autonomous college affiliated to the University of Mumbai
records.evidence: The college's official website identifies Narsee Monjee College of Commerce & Economics as an empowered autonomous college affiliated to the University of Mumbai and provides undergraduate admission requirements.
records.notes: Managed by Shri Vile Parle Kelavani Mandal; funding classification was not stated on the official page, so ownership is recorded as trust.

records.name: Christ University
records.statutory_basis: Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956 (Gazette notification, 22 July 2008)
records.evidence: CHRIST's official disclosures identify it as CHRIST (Deemed to be University), recognised by the Ministry of Education under Section 3 of the UGC Act, with Christ Educational Society as sponsoring body; the university publishes undergraduate and postgraduate programmes.
records.notes: Private deemed university; the canonical family row is private_deemed.

records.name: Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce
records.statutory_basis: UGC autonomous grant-in-aid college affiliated to Savitribai Phule Pune University
records.evidence: The official college page states that Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce is autonomous under UGC, continues under Savitribai Phule Pune University for degree conferral, and offers undergraduate, postgraduate and PhD programmes; its official prospectus identifies it as grant-in-aid.
records.notes: This is the autonomous affiliated college, not Symbiosis International (a separate deemed university).

records.name: Lady Shri Ram College for Women
records.statutory_basis: Constituent college of the University of Delhi (Central University)
records.evidence: LSR's official NAAC self-study report identifies Lady Shri Ram College as a constituent college of the University of Delhi; the official college site describes its student-facing undergraduate and postgraduate programmes.
records.notes: Constituent-college row under the central University of Delhi.

records.name: St. Josephs College of Commerce
records.statutory_basis: UGC autonomous college affiliated to Bengaluru City University; managed by Bangalore Jesuit Educational Society
records.evidence: The official institution page states that St Joseph's College of Commerce is managed by the Bangalore Jesuit Educational Society and received autonomous status from UGC; official admission materials identify current BCom and other programmes affiliated to Bengaluru City University.
records.notes: Name retained exactly as supplied; official branding uses St. Joseph's College of Commerce.

records.name: Hans Raj College
records.statutory_basis: Constituent college of the University of Delhi (Central University)
records.evidence: Hans Raj College's official page states that it is a constituent college of the University of Delhi and imparts education at undergraduate and graduate levels to students.
records.notes: Existing legacy-type research also confirmed the constituent-college status from this official page.
